function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The analysis adjusted for the confounding by customer_segment by computing a stratified average revenue per converted order. This was done by computing the mean revenue within each (channel, segment) group, then weighting these means by the segment distribution within each channel. This method ensures that differences in segment composition do not bias the comparison. The resulting difference in average revenue between channels is therefore adjusted for the imbalance in customer_segment and reflects a fairer estimate of campaign effect."}
